title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
想要奋斗的马寻回到了府邸，又开始休息了，这段时间他都白净了些，也不再是双颊凹陷，总算是有了点风采。何大跑到了书房前，“国舅爷，陛下赐的骏马送来了。”马寻立刻来了兴趣，好奇问道，“是什么马？汗血马？”“哪有什么汗血马，都是些常见的战马、骑乘马。”何大解释说道，“战马难驯，性情也多暴烈，国舅现在不好骑。送来的都是温顺的骑乘马，供国舅练习骑术。”马寻更加感兴趣了，“先前陛下就教了我骑术，只是没能再练下去。我都会骑驴，骑马肯定也不难。”准备练习骑术的马寻说道，“府里还是小了点施展不开，我们是去兵营练习，还是去城外？”“去城外吧，兵营现在也在操练。”何大建议说道，“再说国舅是要去军中，真要是让那些丘八见着国舅不会骑马，他们必定私下嗤笑。”马寻没好气说道，“你本就是当过兵，说他们丘八，你算什么？”何大理直气壮的说道，“俺以前也是丘八，现在不在军中，俺叫他们丘八又如何？”行，还好不是‘贼配军’，丘八这都算是文明用语了。旺财有些暴躁，它习惯了自个儿独占马厩，看到旁边的‘高头大马’就急的直叫唤。看到马寻去拍拍那些马的脖子、摸摸马脸，更为着急。“国舅，旺财通人性。”何大喜笑颜开的说道，“跑是跑不起来，也难驮起来甲士，平时骑着倒是不赖。”马寻有些好笑的说道，“这些马就牵去其他地方养着，旺财到底不同。”何大等人也没意见，旺财不是单纯的牲畜，这是陪着国舅从福建走回宿州的，一岁多的小驴就拖着徐王的棺椁走了半年多，皇帝和皇后都喜欢这头驴呢。更何况往常除了喜欢叫唤之外，也确实通人性，大家对它更喜爱也正常。马寻刚出府，在街上瞎跑的常茂眼尖跑了过来，“舅舅这是要去哪？”“去练习骑术。”马寻就笑着说道，“怎么，还想要教一教我？”常茂天不怕地不怕，立刻说道，“舅舅，俺自小跟着俺爹练习骑术，俺能在马上张弓射箭，五十步外的靶子都能射中！”这位‘常太爷’也是奇葩，骄纵的厉害，说他是二世祖绝对不夸张。不过看着现在也就是十三岁的常茂，马寻也不多在意，“去牵一匹马，我倒是要看看你是什么本事。”随即马寻提醒说道，“万万要和你娘说一声，千万别不声不响的跑了。”常茂一溜烟的朝着府里跑去，显然是欢天喜地。

等到常茂再次出现的时候确实牵着匹骏马，还有常婉。常婉微微屈膝行礼，“果真是舅舅要带着你去习练骑术。”常茂忍不住抱怨说道，“姐，俺说的是实话，俺岂敢诓骗你和娘！”“我带着出去，我不擅长骑马，这小子说他骑术精湛，我倒是要看看。”马寻就笑着说道，“他除了骑术、箭术之外，还有没有其他本事？”常婉解释说道，“舅舅不要给他骗了，他骑术谈不上精湛，箭术也一般。刀用的好，家里都用枪，偏偏他就喜欢用刀。”马寻非常感兴趣的问道，“是短刀还是长刀？”刀就是统称了，明朝的骑兵、步兵都用的兵器就有腰刀，虽然现在火器发展的迅猛，但是刀依然是制式武器。“俺喜欢用长刀，最好是麻札刀。”常茂抢先说道，“俺力气大，以后肯定能一刀将鞑子连人带马斩成两段。短刀俺也厉害，用的是斩马刀。”斩马刀据说是从唐朝的陌刀演变而来，在宋朝时是步兵的武器，只是这也不短啊，据说三尺有余，那就是一米的长度了。常婉看着常茂说道，“既然舅舅愿意带着你，你就跟着一起去习练骑术。不得放肆，要不然回来有你好看的！”常茂连连点头，爹娘不舍得打他，但是姐姐打人的时候是真的不留情。马寻笑着对常婉说道，“一会儿你去趟御史中丞府，替我借几本书。医书方面的多问些，要不然就问问一些农学、机关的。”常婉抿着嘴笑，随即问道，“舅舅，那外甥女是该借到书，还是借不到书？”常茂就立刻插话，显摆自己的厉害，“姐，舅舅都说让你去借书，肯定是要借到！”“闭嘴！”常婉的话快，手更快，巴掌已经打在了常茂的脑袋上了，“读书读不明白也就算了，脑子也不会动？”马寻想了想说道，“你先去问问，问问那边可有一些治疗外伤的法子，或者是一些个酿酒的好法子。”常婉立刻严肃起来，说道，“舅舅，陛下现在可没有解除禁酒令。虽然现在京城也有不少酒，只是如今粮食还是不够。”当年打天下的时候，为了节约粮食，朱元璋严令禁酒。手下大将胡大海的儿子胡三舍私自制酒，可是被朱元璋正法了。马寻明白这个道理，说道，“你先去问问，我肯定不会私下酿酒敛财。”常婉仔细想了想，笑着问道，“那外甥女怎么也要问出来些门道，只是不甚明了，到时候需要舅舅亲自去问，如何？”

Ma Xun, who wanted to work hard, returned to the mansion and began to rest again. During this time, he became fairer, his cheeks were no longer sunken, and he finally had some charm.He Da ran to the study and said, "Uncle, the horse given by Your Majesty has been delivered." Ma Xun immediately became interested and asked curiously, "What kind of horse is it? A sweat horse?" "There are no sweat horses. They are all common war horses and riding horses." He Da explained, "War horses are difficult to tame and have bad temperaments."Duo Luo, it's not easy for my uncle to ride now. All the horses he sent were docile riding horses for him to practice riding."Ma Xun became more interested, "Your Majesty taught me riding skills before, but I couldn't continue to practice them. I can ride a donkey, and it will definitely not be difficult for me to ride.""The mansion is still too small to perform. Should we go to the barracks to practice, or go outside the city?" "Let's go outside the city. The barracks are also practicing now." He Da suggested, "Besides, uncle Guo is going to the army. If those Qiu Ba see that uncle Guo can't ride a horse, they will laugh in private."Ma Xun said angrily, "You have been a soldier, so who do you think you are when you call them Qiu Ba?" He Dali said confidently, "I used to be Qiu Ba, but now I am not in the army, so what if I call them Qiu Ba?" OK, fortunately, it is not a 'thief joining the army', Qiu Ba is considered a civilized term.Wangcai is a bit irritable. He is used to having the stables to himself, and he barks anxiously when he sees the 'big horse' next to him.He was even more anxious when he saw Ma Xun patting the horses' necks and touching their faces."Uncle Guo, Wangcai is connected with human nature." He Daxi said with a smile, "You can't run, and it's hard to carry soldiers on your back. It's not bad to ride on it." Ma Xun said a little funny, "I'll take these horses to other places to raise them. WangcaiIt's different after all." He Da and others also had no objection. Wangcai was not a simple animal. He accompanied his uncle from Fujian back to Suzhou. The one-year-old donkey dragged King Xu's coffin for more than half a year. Both the emperor and the empress liked this donkey.What's more, in addition to liking to bark, it is indeed humane, and it is normal for everyone to like it more.As soon as Ma Xun left the house, Chang Mao, who was running around on the street, ran over with sharp eyes, "Uncle, where are you going?" "To practice riding." Ma Xun said with a smile, "Why, you still want to teach me?" Chang Maotian was not afraid, and immediatelyHe said, "Uncle, I have been practicing riding skills with my father since I was a child. I can draw a bow on a horse and shoot an arrow, and I can hit a target fifty paces away!" This 'Mr. Chang' is also strange and very arrogant. It is definitely not an exaggeration to say that he is the second generation ancestor.But looking at Chang Mao, who was now thirteen years old, Ma Xun didn't pay much attention. "Go and fetch a horse. I want to see what you are capable of." Then Ma Xun reminded, "You must tell your mother and don't run away silently." Chang Mao quickly ran towards the house, obviously very happy.

When Chang Mao appeared again, he was indeed holding a horse and Chang Wan.Chang Wan bowed slightly and saluted, "It's true that my uncle wants to take you to practice riding." Chang Mao couldn't help complaining, "Sister, I'm telling the truth. How dare I lie to you and mother!" "I'll take you out. I'm not good at riding. This guy said he has excellent riding skills. I want to see it." Ma Xun said with a smile, "In addition to riding and archery, does he have any other skills?" Chang Wan?He explained, "Uncle, don't let him fool you. His riding skills are far from superb, and his archery skills are average. He is good at using knives. Everyone uses guns at home, but he likes to use knives." Ma Xun asked with great interest, "Is it a short sword or a long sword?" The sword is a general term. The weapon used by the cavalry and infantry in the Ming Dynasty was the waist knife. Although firearms are developing rapidly now, the sword is still the standard weapon."I like to use long swords, preferably Mazha swords." Chang Mao said first, "I am strong. I will definitely be able to cut a Tatar man and his horse into two pieces with one sword in the future. I am also good at short swords, and I use a horse-cutting knife." The horse-cutting knife is said to have evolved from the Mo Dao of the Tang Dynasty. It was an infantry weapon in the Song Dynasty, but it is not short. It is said to be more than three feet, which is one meter in length.Chang Wan looked at Chang Mao and said, "Since uncle is willing to take you, you should go with me to practice riding. Don't be arrogant, or you will look good when I come back!" Chang Mao nodded repeatedly. His parents were reluctant to beat him, but his sister was really merciless when she beat someone.Ma Xun smiled and said to Chang Wan, "You will go to the Yushi Zhongcheng's Mansion later and borrow some books for me. Ask more about medical books, or ask some people in agriculture and government agencies." Chang Wan pursed her lips and smiled, and then asked, "Uncle, that nephewShould I borrow the book, or should I borrow it?" Chang Mao immediately interrupted, showing off his power, "Sister, my uncle asked you to borrow the book, so you must borrow it!" "Shut up!" Chang Wan spoke quickly, and his hand was even faster, and he slapped Chang.Mao's head was on his head, "It's okay if you can't understand the reading, and you can't use your brain?" Ma Xun thought for a while and said, "Go and ask first. Ask if there are some methods to treat trauma or some good methods to make wine." Chang WanHe immediately became serious and said, "Uncle, Your Majesty has not lifted the ban on alcohol now. Although there is a lot of alcohol in the capital, the food is still not enough." When he was conquering the world, in order to save food, Zhu Yuanzhang strictly banned alcohol.Hu Sanshe, the son of his general Hu Dahai, secretly made wine, but was executed by Zhu Yuanzhang.Ma Xun understood this and said, "You go and ask first. I will definitely not make money by brewing wine privately." Chang Wan thought about it carefully and asked with a smile, "Then my niece has to ask for some knowledge, but it's not clear. Then I need to ask my uncle in person, how about it?"
